description: This Java test class, 'LoanReschedulingWithinCenterTest', contains integration tests for loan rescheduling functionalities within a loan center context, including scenarios for interest recalculations, multi-tranche loans, and meeting date adjustments. It orchestrates setup of test data like offices, centers, clients, loan products, and executes various loan lifecycle operations to verify correct behavior after rescheduling.
